decision: CharacterDialogue is a genuine immutable nominal runtime value.
CharacterDialogue is not RuntimeFunctionValue and does not alter ordinary currying.
Add RuntimeValue::NominalRecord because current AWBC nominal records lose identity.
arcweft-dialogue owns CharacterDialogue/config/patch/application domain types.
arcweft-character remains the sole CharacterId and look identity owner.
CharacterDialoguePatch is a checked/runtime instruction operand, not a standalone author-constructible value.
CharacterDialogue stores an effective immutable config and contract digests.
Explicit None clears earlier values; required view resets to std.view.dialogue.
id and text_key are accepted only by the outer configuration call immediately consumed by content.
Custom named arguments resolve to typed stable field IDs in an immutable registry.
Source spans remain in syntax/HIR/sema/AWBC source maps, not runtime identity.
Parentheses configure; brackets/colon apply content through shared resolver families.
TypeKind::CharacterDialogue carries Exact(CharacterId) or Any.
Aliases, branches, returns, captures, collections, and indirect content application are allowed.
@say.* remains only a line-entity namespace.
Generated line IDs derive from typed source owner/scope/ordinal, never character.
Absent text_key derives text.<line suffix>; explicit keys remain text.*.
DialogueLine is a checked executable line operation; plan out determines the user result.
AWBC switches atomically to ABI 2 / codec 8 with no previous reader.
Bundle session save switches atomically to schema 2 with no schema-1 reader.
AWBC Dialogue terminator consumes a validated CharacterDialogue register.
Static content catalog and runtime effective character/config frame are separate.
Runtime/display/Agent identity fields are character_id and character_display_name, not callee/speaker_label.
Hot-reload rebinding requires exact contract sub-digests; otherwise stale.
Old Speaker/preset values, AWBC1/codec7, save1, and dialogue-callee observation/debug payloads are rejected; generic root replay v1 is retained.
Canonicalization expands colon to brackets and never emits .say.
Formatter formats accepted surface without semantic rewrites; canonicalizer owns colon expansion.
.say fails through ordinary missing-method/type resolution only.
AW-AH-009.4 publishes typed character payload; 009.4.1 only maps authored View projection.
Every required Speaker/SayOptions/preset/suffix path is deleted directly.
Patch expressions evaluate in source order, validate completely, and commit atomically.
Equality/hash use canonical normalized bytes and exclude source/display spellings.
Only native typed View/text path is permitted.
All result-changing decisions are frozen in this package.
